# Reader PDF Fixtures

These PDFs are generated by `node scripts/create-reader-pdf-fixtures.mjs`.

They are intentionally tiny, self-owned fixtures for future Reader PDF parser tests. They are not production content and do not require external attribution.

## Oversize Fixture
Do not commit a `>50MB` PDF fixture. Generate it locally when parser tests are added so the existing `MAX_READER_FILE_SIZE_BYTES` guard can be verified without storing large binary files in git.
